title: Spiral Matrix II
description:
Given a positive integer n , generate an n x n matrix filled with elements from 1 to n 2 in spiral order. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/11/13/spiraln.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 n = 3

Output:
 [[1,2,3],[8,9,4],[7,6,5]]
```

 Example 2: 
 
```
Input:
 n = 1

Output:
 [[1]]
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= n <= 20
